MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Roll pins and fender washers complement the cotter pins, rivet nuts, and bolt assortments I have bought by giving me more ways to secure parts and distribute fastening loads.",
    "The lag bolt assortment offers several lengths for heavier wood fastening jobs, fitting my repeated interest in keeping useful hardware sizes on hand."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The pneumatic valve and pressure gauge require particular tubing, connections, and tasks that my purchases do not establish a need for.",
    "Calibration weights do not follow naturally from buying a caliper and infrared thermometer; those tools serve different measurement needs.",
    "Adhesive, electrical leads, and repair tape could be useful, but usefulness alone does not give me a reason to buy them today, especially in larger quantities."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning repair tools seemed to be taken as a reason I would need specialized equipment for almost any repair task.",
    "My interest in hardware assortments seemed to extend too broadly to bulk supplies and individual fastener sizes, even when I have no matching job."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated assortment purchases suggest that having several usable sizes matters more to me than adding one specific size without an immediate purpose.",
    "I distinguish between hardware that complements supplies I already own and equipment that requires a new task or setup.",
    "Quantity matters differently for different supplies: varied fasteners give me options, while several identical adhesive cartridges or tape rolls need a clearer reason to stock up."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my interest in versatile fastening supplies but assumed too much immediate need for specialized tools and bulk consumables."
}
